integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo the cited fiber and cycle lemmas, both re-established in the text. Finite tests corroborate definitions and constructions, but do not certify the universal claim.
scientific_claim: For every pair of integers \(m,n\ge5\), the Cartesian toroidal grid \(C_m\square C_n\) has minimum monitoring edge-geodetic number \[\operatorname{meg}(C_m\square C_n)=3\max\{m,n\}.\] For \(5\le m\le n\), an explicit arrangement with exactly three selected vertices per \(C_m\)-fiber attains the lower bound \(3n\). A balanced-floor cyclic-block construction works for all but \((m,n)=(5,6),(7,8)\), where stated explicit placements give the bound. The known equal-side case is subsumed, but not novel.
scientific_limitations: Only simple Cartesian cycle products with both orders at least five; optimal-set classification and strong products not addressed. Square case is previously known. Related publisher full texts for Xu et al. (2024) and Tan et al. (2023) could not be inspected.
title: Exact monitoring edge-geodetic numbers of rectangular toroidal grids
